FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.IndependentStudentQuestion: Explain the visual difference between direct linear variation y=4x and direct quadratic variation y=4x².
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.TeacherExpectedMath: y=4x is a straight line through the origin; y=4x² is a parabola through the origin; both have a constant multiplier.
FirstPartyIndependentStudentMathQuestion.OriginalSourceMathematicsReviewed: Direct y=kx graph is a straight line through origin when variation is first power; direct higher powers may be curves.
